rows.name: Direct: motor on the Ø60 drum, 4:1 capstan
rows.note: no reducer at all; the joint gets 4 x the motor's torque

rows.name: Largest single capstan: Ø14 drum, Ø300 sector (21:1)
rows.note: 1.8 mm rope at SF 3 on the burst torque; 7.6 working turns on the motor drum (a winch, not a capstan)

rows.name: Two rope stages, 10 x 10 (100:1)
rows.note: 36 turns on the motor drum for 130 deg of joint travel: a multi-layer winch at 3600 rpm

rows.name: Belt 5:1 + belt 5:1 + capstan 4:1 (100:1)
rows.note: stage-2 pulley carries 61 N·m continuous / 182 burst: HTD 8M, 30 mm wide, a Ø300 large pulley that does not fit the Ø192 pod

rows.name: 25-lobe cycloid + 4:1 capstan (100:1, as costed)
rows.note: the cost-search pick: reducer lines $112, capstan lines $58 at 20 units

rows.name: OTS 25:1 planetary (PLE/PLF-60 class) + 4:1 capstan
rows.note: a 60-frame two-stage planetary is listed around $120-160 (est, unverified) and rated ~40-60 N·m; the 66 N·m continuous here is at its limit, an 80-frame is $200+

rows.name: Quasi-direct: 10-inch hub motor on a 10:1 capstan
rows.note: 15 N·m heat-sunk from a Ø250 x 60 hub (est), 12 of them add 54 kg; the pod would be Ø260 and the sector Ø300; 8.4 rad/s joint no-load is fast enough but the mass never closes
